title: DBFlux redesign: home page live demo
brief: Imported from Claude.ai artifact RrT5VLW14vaPQzV1ab71hT: the scroll-driven home page demo, its keyframes, static fallback and motion spec.

artboards.title: Live demo: scroll-scrubbed prototype
artboards.tradeoff: Scroll-driven live demo: chapters and skip sit left under the copy, with an explicit scroll hint; needs JS and motion, here frozen at its first frame.

artboards.title: Motion spec and open questions
artboards.tradeoff: Motion spec and open questions: pins timing and decisions; text-heavy.

artboards.title: Keyframes, dark
artboards.tradeoff: Keyframes, dark: every demo step laid out for review; a storyboard, not the shipped page.

artboards.title: Keyframes, light
artboards.tradeoff: Keyframes, light: the same storyboard on the light theme; a storyboard, not the shipped page.

artboards.title: Static fallback: 1180 px and below, reduced motion, no JS
artboards.tradeoff: Static fallback: works at 1180 px and below, with reduced motion and without JS; loses the scroll story.
